json_ld_descriptions: Philadelphia personal injury law firm with 25+ years of experience. Auto accidents, slip and falls, and disability claims. Se habla español. Free consults.

Shipon Law Associates is a Philadelphia, Pennsylvania personal injury law firm representing injured individuals and families throughout Philadelphia County and the surrounding region.

For more than 25 years, the firm has handled serious personal injury and disability claims arising in Philadelphia and across Pennsylvania, including car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle crashes, pedestrian injuries, slip and fall accidents, premises liability cases, workplace injuries, catastrophic injury claims, wrongful death lawsuits, and Social Security Disability matters.

As experienced Philadelphia personal injury attorneys, the lawyers at Shipon Law Associates pursue full financial recovery for medical expenses, lost wages, diminished earning capacity, pain and suffering, and long-term disability benefits.

The firm provides personalized legal representation, direct attorney access, and strategic case preparation designed to maximize settlements and trial verdicts in Pennsylvania courts.

Free consultations are available, and cases are handled on a contingency fee basis.

Se habla español.
